new_claim.scope: Exact-rank-three target; one original-coordinate spectral row has leverage c>=1/2; after aligning that row, every residual row is either longitudinal (parallel to e1) or transverse (orthogonal to e1), with those classes on disjoint original coordinates.
new_claim.conclusion: For arbitrary independent input densities bounded by one, ||p_(X^T A X)||_infinity < 248.

Near-null scalar/dependent-pair density theorem and exact-null endpoint, with explicit density-cap normalization.

first_unpaid_implication.statement: For a heavy exact-rank-three row, residual longitudinal and transverse coefficient columns are globally orthogonal but may overlap on the same original coordinates. Prove a full-line interval/coarea bound uniform through this overlap, including the singular support-separated limit, without treating orthogonality as independence or using conditional caps/fiber suprema/small random perturbations.
